name: vscode-claude-statusline
description: Editor stats and live Claude Code session usage (model, tokens, cost, context %, multi-session and history) in the VS Code status bar.

claudeStatusline.enabled.description: Show the Claude Code session status bar item.

claudeStatusline.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to re-check the transcript file in addition to the file watcher, in milliseconds.

claudeStatusline.contextWindowTokens.description: Context window size (in tokens) used to estimate the context-usage percentage shown in the status bar and to calibrate compaction detection. Defaults to 1,000,000 (current Sonnet/Opus/Fable models); lower this if you're on a 200K-window model like Haiku 4.5.

claudeStatusline.sessionFile.description: Absolute path to a specific Claude Code .jsonl transcript to track. Takes priority over both auto-detection and the 'Switch Primary Session' command. Leave empty to auto-detect the most recently modified session for the current workspace under ~/.claude/projects/.

claudeStatusline.pricing.description: USD price per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by model id, e.g. { "claude-sonnet-5": { "inputPerMillion": 3, "outputPerMillion": 15, "cacheWritePerMillion": 3.75, "cacheReadPerMillion": 0.3 } }. Built-in default rates ship for the current Sonnet/Opus/Haiku/Fable models; entries here override or add to those defaults. Verify current Anthropic pricing before configuring a custom entry, since the extension does not fetch or guess rates. Models with no default and no configured entry show cost as n/a.
